name: @gjsify/node-runtime-win32-x64
description: Bundled Node.js interpreter for Windows x64 — just the `node.exe` binary from a pinned Node 24 LTS release plus its LICENSE, for apps that `gjsify ship` packages where no system Node can be assumed. Platform-gated (win32/x64 only). Node.js is a registered trademark of the OpenJS Foundation; this package is not affiliated with, endorsed, or sponsored by the OpenJS Foundation.
